text:
chris: Heads up — our canary cluster in eu-west3 is failing after the NCCL 3.0 bump. Seeing allreduce hangs and p2p timeouts on A100 nodes.

maya: Got the pager. Which hosts are affected? Any obvious error lines in the logs?

chris: Canary hosts a100-p2p-eu-w3-12..15. Symptoms: worker stuck at step 143, nv_peer2peer connect timeouts, and repeated 'nccl: unhandled error' in the runtime logs.

sasha: Can you set NCCL_DEBUG=INFO on one failing host and collect /var/log/nccl-*.log and dmesg? Need traces to see where it blocks.

chris: Pasting quick snippet from node-13: ```[2026-04-02T09:12:03Z] ncclNet: connect timeout to 10.0.5.23:3344
[2026-04-02T09:12:03Z] nccl: Allreduce entered (op sum) but no completion after 120s
[2026-04-02T09:12:05Z] nv_peer2peer: peer connect failed: errno=110
```

alex: We also measured tail latency doubling on 4-GPU inference routes. GPU util drops to ~10% while nvlink traffic spikes. Looks like collectives block compute.

infra-oncall-bot: Alert: 3 canaries failing in eu-west3 (severity P2). See incident dashboard: https://console.redwood/alerts/1768765432

maya: Immediate mitigation: pin the canaries back to NCCL 2.x image and pause the rollout. Who owns the rollout job?

chris: deploy-bot started the rollout. Canary group rollout-2026-04-02-17. My recommendation: rollback canary group only and keep rest paused until we investigate.

deploy-bot: Rollback command issued for rollout-2026-04-02-17 -> canary group. ETA ~8m.

sasha: While rollback runs I'll start capturing kernel perf traces and DCGM nvlink metrics on host-12 to correlate. Also will enable NCCL_NET_GDR=0/1 toggles to test fallback paths.

rachel: Any customer impact? Do hosted tenants see errors?

chris: Minimal customer errors so far — <0.1% request failures on eu-west3, but a noticeable increase in streaming latency for LLM endpoints. No full outage.

tom: Proposal: (1) pause rollout (done), (2) collect nccl logs + DCGM + dmesg, (3) revert canaries (in progress), (4) run stress harness at higher batch sizes to reproduce, (5) engage NVIDIA if rollback doesn't fix. Schedule 30m war room in #incidents if rollback incomplete.

maya: Starting log collection and will upload artifacts to the infra bucket. Adding labels: nccl-3.0, a100, eu-west3.

chris: Observed hint: kernel module version on these hosts is one release older than the one our CI used when building the NCCL 3.0 package. Suspect driver/kernel ABI mismatch with new NCCL P2P code paths.

sasha: If rollback clears canaries we still need a compatibility matrix test across kernel, CUDA, driver, and NCCL. I'll open a follow-up ticket to add that to integration canaries.

chris: Filed INF-9123 for follow-up compatibility testing and test harness.

deploy-bot: Rollback completed for canary group at 1768765588.

chris: Canary health recovered post-rollback. Marking this thread as investigation ongoing; will assemble a short postmortem after artifacts are in. Thanks everyone. :thank_you:
